reasons.F001: Provides React + TanStack Router scaffold with Vite, authentication setup, UI components (Card, Skeleton, Button)
reasons.F017: Projects oRPC router needed for /projects list and detail queries
reasons.F018: Features oRPC router needed for feature detail queries and filtering by projectId

discoveries.discovery: vite build must be run to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts after adding new route files
discoveries.context: F020 added 3 new route files (.tsx), but TypeScript compilation failed until 'vite build' was run to generate updated routeTree.gen.ts
discoveries.lesson: TanStack Router file-based routing requires explicit build step to scan route directory and generate type definitions. Cannot skip this step.
discoveries.root_cause: Route file-based routing needs code generation; vite build triggers TanStack Router plugin which scans /routes/ directory
discoveries.prevention: After adding .tsx files to apps/web/src/routes/, always run 'vite build' before type-checking. Add to feature checklist: 'Run vite build to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts'

discoveries.discovery: Client-side feature filtering works when API lacks projectId filtering
discoveries.context: Features oRPC router list() procedure doesn't accept projectId filter (only status/phase). F020 routes filter in-memory: allFeatures.data?.filter((f) => f.projectId === projectId)
discoveries.lesson: Frontend can compensate for incomplete backend API by filtering client-side. Useful for MVP, but indicates missing API feature.
discoveries.trade_off: Client-side filtering works for small datasets (<1000 features), but wastes bandwidth. Recommendation: add projectId filter to feature list API in next feature.
discoveries.prevention: Document API gaps when discovered. Add to feature spec for next feature: 'features.list() should accept optional projectId filter'

discoveries.discovery: Biome noArrayIndexKey lint error with Array.from + map skeleton pattern
discoveries.context: F020 tried to create skeleton loaders with Array.from(Array(3)).map((_, i) => <Skeleton key={i}/>). Biome flagged noArrayIndexKey violation (array indexes not reliable for keys).
discoveries.lesson: Biome's noArrayIndexKey rule applies to dynamically generated elements. Static skeleton patterns should use explicit elements instead of .map().
discoveries.solution_applied: Replaced Array.from() pattern with inline Skeleton elements: <Skeleton/><Skeleton/><Skeleton/>
discoveries.code_pattern_bad:
// Causes noArrayIndexKey lint error:
{Array.from(Array(3)).map((_, i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-24 w-full" />)}
discoveries.code_pattern_good: // Biome-compliant skeleton pattern:
discoveries.prevention: For skeleton/placeholder patterns with fixed count, inline elements. For dynamic lists, use proper key strategy.

discoveries.discovery: beforeLoad auth guard pattern protects routes effectively
discoveries.context: All 3 new routes use beforeLoad hook with authClient.getSession() check. Redirects unauthenticated users to /login with throw: true.
discoveries.lesson: TanStack Router's beforeLoad is ideal place for auth checks. Runs before component mounts, can throw redirect.
discoveries.prevention: Use beforeLoad for all protected routes. Prevents component render for unauthenticated users. Cleaner than permission checks inside component.

discoveries.discovery: oRPC query pattern with queryOptions() enables type-safe data fetching
discoveries.context: F020 uses useQuery(orpc.projects.list.queryOptions()) and useQuery(orpc.features.get.queryOptions({input: {...}})). Query options generated from oRPC schema at build time.
discoveries.lesson: TanStack Query's queryOptions() pattern provides autocomplete and type safety for query keys and fetching logic. Coupled with oRPC types.
discoveries.benefit: 1) Type-safe input validation, 2) Automatic query key derivation, 3) Cached queries by default, 4) Consistent error handling
discoveries.prevention: Always use .queryOptions() pattern from oRPC client. Never construct query keys manually in frontend.

patterns_applied.name: ROUTE_TREE_GENERATION
patterns_applied.how_used: Added 3 new route files, ran 'vite build' to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts with type definitions for new routes
patterns_applied.benefit: Type-safe route params and links. Route tree auto-updated without manual type definitions.

patterns_applied.name: PATTERN_REUSE
patterns_applied.how_used: Copied existing route patterns from F001 scaffold (projects.index.tsx from dashboard.tsx, projects.$projectId.tsx from login.tsx structure, features.$featureId.tsx as new pattern but following established beforeLoad auth guard)
patterns_applied.benefit: 21-minute implementation. Consistent auth patterns, component structure, data fetching approach across all routes.

what_worked: beforeLoad auth guard pattern prevents unauthenticated access at route level before component render
useQuery with queryOptions() from oRPC provides type-safe data fetching from server routers
TanStack Router params validation via Route.useParams() returns typed params
Skeleton loaders provide good UX for data loading states
Card components with status color indicators (statusColors object) provide visual feedback
Client-side feature filtering works well for MVP (filters allFeatures by projectId)
Link components with params prop enable type-safe navigation
All 4 acceptance criteria met on first implementation (no retries needed)
what_could_improve: Feature list API should accept optional projectId filter to avoid client-side filtering
Session list API should be queried on project detail page to show agent execution status
Routes could show feature creator/owner information if added to Feature schema
Feature detail page could show related sessions (agent executions) if API updated
Project/feature list pages could have search/filter controls
Status indicator dots could use <Badge> component instead of plain divs for consistency
Route params could be validated with Zod before use (currently relies on query to fail if not found)

recommendations.recommendation: Add projectId filter to features.list() oRPC router
recommendations.rationale: Currently client filters allFeatures by projectId. Server-side filtering would reduce bandwidth and enable server-side pagination.
recommendations.action: Enhance F018 featureRouter.list() input schema to accept optional projectId, filter in handler before returning

recommendations.recommendation: Add sessions display to project detail page
recommendations.rationale: Users should see agent session history and output for features in a project
recommendations.action: Query sessions API in /projects/$projectId route, display recent sessions with status badges and elapsed time

recommendations.recommendation: Extract statusColors object to shared theme/colors module
recommendations.rationale: Both /projects/$projectId and /features/$featureId define same statusColors. Frontend codebase will have many pages with status indicators.
recommendations.action: Create apps/web/src/lib/colors.ts with status color constants, import in all pages that need them

recommendations.recommendation: Use <Badge> component for status indicators instead of plain divs
recommendations.rationale: UI consistency. Badge component should have status variants (backlog, pending, in_progress, etc.)
recommendations.action: Add status variant to Badge component, replace statusColors pattern with <Badge variant={feature.status} />

recommendations.recommendation: Add Zod param validation to routes for extra safety
recommendations.rationale: Route params like projectId, featureId are typed but not validated. Invalid IDs reach component before query fails.
recommendations.action: Add route.validateParams() with Zod schemas or validate in beforeLoad before rendering component

TanStack Router file-based routing - no manual routing config needed
oRPC integration - type-safe queries from server routers
UI components from scaffold - Card, Skeleton, Button ready to use

efficiency_analysis.comparison_to_baseline: Average feature (19 features): 19.4 min. F020: 21 min. Very close to average despite being first web routes. Shows good pattern reuse efficiency.
efficiency_analysis.pattern_reuse_value: Estimated 10+ minutes of UI design time eliminated by reusing existing components. Auth guard pattern copied from F001.

code_quality_notes.type_safety: Full type safety: Route.useParams() typed, oRPC queries typed, no 'any' types
code_quality_notes.component_structure: Clear separation: beforeLoad for auth, component for rendering, data fetching in component hooks
code_quality_notes.error_handling: Routes handle loading, error (not found), and success states for all data queries
code_quality_notes.accessibility: Links use semantic HTML, status indicators use visual + text (color + emoji), good color contrast
code_quality_notes.responsive_design: Grid layouts use Tailwind classes, responsive container width (max-w-4xl), mobile-friendly spacing

architectural_insights.route_organization: File-based routing (projects.index, projects.$projectId, features.$featureId) is clear and discoverable. One file per route.
architectural_insights.data_fetching: useQuery pattern consistent with React Query conventions. Type-safe queries from oRPC routers.
architectural_insights.auth_pattern: beforeLoad hook is ideal place for auth checks. Prevents render, redirects cleanly.
architectural_insights.component_design: Presentational components (route pages) are thin wrappers around data queries and UI components. Good separation from business logic.
architectural_insights.api_integration: Frontend queries backend via oRPC client (generated from server routers). Type-safe end-to-end.
